title: Alignment
description: How the venture's products and agents must behave (EE-053): a list of principles, each with its source and the check that holds it, at <venture>/purpose/alignment.json. A foundation statement, gated: an agent's change is a draft the founder accepts.

statement.description: What must always or never happen, in the founder's words

applies_to.description: Product ids, or agents or team, that the principle binds

source.description: Who or what it comes from: the founder's words with a date, a decision id or a reference

check.description: The test or script that holds it, or null when nothing checks it yet
